# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v3 c38 P20](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0020), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** College student and writer  <sub>[v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is an exceptionally handsome and distinguished-looking young man with dark, melancholy, inscrutable eyes and thick brown hair. He possesses a remarkably good figure and a fine, clever face. His voice is melting, musical, and sympathetic, and he dresses with great style.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 c25 P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 c33 P28](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0028), [v3 c34 P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020)_

## Personality

Roy is courtly, chivalrous, and deeply romantic, frequently expressing himself in poetic compliments and sentiment. He is earnest, ambitious, and dutiful, having willingly paused his education to travel abroad with his ailing mother. However, he lacks a strong sense of humor, often failing to grasp jokes or funny stories.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c33 P5](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0005), [v3 c33 P25](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0025), [v3 c34 P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024)_

## History

Roy Gardner completed his Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond College before taking a two-year hiatus to travel throughout Europe with his mother for her health. Upon returning to Kingsport to resume his Junior year at Redmond, he met Anne Shirley in the park during a heavy November rainstorm when her umbrella turned inside out. He rescued her under a pavilion and accompanied her home, subsequently sending her a dozen roses and courting her intensely throughout their remaining college years. During their Senior year, his mother and sisters called upon Anne, cementing his family's acceptance of her. On the eve of their departure from Redmond, Roy took Anne to the park pavilion where they first met and formally proposed marriage. To his shock, Anne rejected him, realizing she did not truly love him. Heartbroken, Roy bade her farewell, believing his life was ruined.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P31](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0031), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c27 P17](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0017), [v3 c36 P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P21](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0021), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)_

## Quotes

> Pardon me—may I offer you the shelter of my umbrella?  <sub>[v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)</sub>

> I feel as if I didn't belong anywhere yet. I put in my Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond two years ago. I've been in Europe ever since. Now I've come back to finish my Arts course.  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)</sub>

> If I had my way I'd shut everything out of your life but happiness and pleasure, Anne.  <sub>[v3 c25 P22](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0022)</sub>

> Will you promise me that some day you'll be my wife?  <sub>[v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018)</sub>

> You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne.  <sub>[v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)</sub>
